reason: The lettuce bed needs a low-power way to drink, and capillary felt with a hose may provide a passive water feed.
expectation: I expect a wick or water delivery setup, though I don't yet know how it will connect to the bed.

alternatives.reason: The circulator seems useful for the potato trough, but I want to prepare the felt and hose first.
The lamp and foil may help light the leaves, but water circulation seems like a good place to start.

effect: The felt and hose made a wick suited to the shallow lettuce bed; it still needs to be fitted to the trough.
reaction: The hose sleeve holding the wick without pinching it is a satisfying practical detail.
reason: I want to fit the wick to the lettuce trough so its roots can draw water with little power.
expectation: I expect the wick to connect the lettuce reservoir to the root bed and provide a passive water feed.

alternatives.reason: The circulator should help the potato bed, but I want to finish fitting the lettuce wick first.

effect: The lettuce bed now draws solution from its own reservoir while retaining air around the roots. The potato bed still needs its low-power water supply.
reaction: The distinction between keeping the granules moist and flooding them is useful.
reason: The spare circulator fits the potato trough and should help complete the watering goal.
expectation: I expect it to circulate solution through the potato bed using little power, though I don't know the details yet.

alternatives.reason: The lamp and foil may help light both beds, but I want to finish their water supply first.

effect: Both beds now have low-power watering: the potato trough uses a pump connected to the reserve outlet. The remaining goal is to light the leaves.
reaction: It is reassuring that the potato bed keeps its dark cover and support while using the backup pump.
reason: The lamp and foil are the only available combination and seem suited to providing light.
expectation: I expect the foil to help direct the lamp's light toward the leaves, though I don't know exactly how it will be arranged.

effect: The hooded lamp now lights both troughs from the nook’s low-power outlet, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The small pool of light behind the quilt is a vivid, satisfying image.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lettuce wick was most worthwhile: it showed how the bed can stay moist while leaving air around the roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then fitting the wick felt somewhat repetitive, although the second step clarified how it worked.

surprise.text: I was interested that the deeper potato trough used a small pump while the shallow lettuce bed could use a wick.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining the felt and hose did not make the exact arrangement clear until the result.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: I want to learn whether the garden survives the storm and what the specimens reveal.
